title: tenant fairness: soft-fallback bridge and backpressure token pool
author: Evelyn Zhang
commits: c1a2f5e: introduce soft_fallback_bridge service and API contract
d4b68a1: implement per-tenant grace credits and token pool allocator
f7e9b23: smoothing window for circuit-breaker reopen decisions
b8c3d4e: telemetry hooks, metrics and new dashboards for fallback decisions

description: Context and motivation: We observed repeated tenant-facing errors during regional egress congestion where the existing regional circuit opened aggressively and tenants with bursty but otherwise healthy traffic were evicted disproportionately. This PR provides a 'soft-fallback bridge' that (1) applies an SLO-aware grace credit to tenants during transient regional stress, (2) runs a proportional backpressure token pool to ensure fairness when shedding, and (3) smooths circuit-breaker reopen/reclose decisions using a short sliding window to prevent thrash. The change addresses three pain points from ENG-1890 and the incident on 2026-02-03: noisy reopen flips, unfair eviction of mid-tier tenants, and inability to quickly admit warm KV-cache lanes after failover. Work items: - implement soft_fallback_bridge service behind /internal/fallback API - add tenant_grace_credit allocator (configurable per-tier) - introduce backpressure_token_pool with weighted fairness - replace binary circuit reopen with smoothed reopen_score over a 30s window - add telemetry: fallback_decision{tenant,region,reason}, grace_credit_usage, token_pool_utilization - add unit/integration tests and e2e canary config Checklist: - [x] design doc reviewed by runtime and product (ENG-2025) - [x] unit tests added - [x] integration tests on perf-canary - [x] telemetry wired into console dashboards - [x] canary baked and monitored for 48h - [x] hotfix patch included for nil-pointer cold path Migration and rollout: Default config off for stable release channel; enabled on dedicated canaries and a controlled percentage (5%) of hosted traffic via rollout flags. Ops knobs: per-tenant credit cap, token pool size, smoothing window length. Backwards compatibility: All API changes are internal; no public API breaking changes. Related: touches regional failover path and KV cache admission logic.

discussion: Diego Romero (reviewer): Overall approach LGTM. Two requests: make the grace credit uncapped only for enterprise tiers and add instrumentation for per-tenant denied-counts. Also please add a small backpressure unit-test that simulates multi-tenant contention.

Evelyn Zhang (author): Addressed: grace credit is capped via config and defaulted to 0 for free tier. Added denied_count metric and a new test backpressure/fairness_test.go that reproduces contention. See commit d4b68a1.

Priya Nair (reviewer): Concern about smoothing window hiding real regressions. Suggest exposing reopen_score percentile to console and alert on sustained low reopen_score. Also confirm that smoothing window doesn't delay detection beyond SLO window.
Evelyn Zhang (author): Exposed reopen_score p50/p95; added SLO-window gating so detection still respects tenant SLO windows. Updated dashboards and alerts.
Liam O'Connor (approver): Verified local and canary runs. Observed more even eviction and faster warm-KV readmits during a controlled spike. Approving pending CI.

release_notes: Add soft-fallback bridge for SLO-aware tenant fairness and a weighted backpressure token pool. Improves regional failover behavior by smoothing circuit reopen decisions and reducing unfair tenant evictions. Default off for main rollout; enabled on canaries. Includes hotfix for cold-start nil panic.
